title: 'UFO' filmed shooting across Devon sky then splitting into pieces
excerpt: 'I got more and more confused when it split out into separate lights and started disappearing and reappearing'
content:
'I got more and more confused when it split out into separate lights and started disappearing and reappearing'

A mysterious "fireball" has been seen shooting across the sky sparking talk of a UFO over Devon. The unexplained lights were captured on camera last night (Friday, October 16) by a number of residents.

Footage shows multiple bright objects appearing to shoot across the sky before splitting up.

One witness, Mason, told DevonLive he saw what looked like a "comet or fireball" in the sky around 8pm near Cullompton.

Mason said: "Mysterious lighting in sky [...] started off as a fireball looking thing before slowing and splitting in these lights. UFOs?

"I got more and more confused when it split out into separate lights and started disappearing and reappearing."

Another witness, Kier, also took footage of the lights near Honiton. He said: "Saw these in the sky near Honiton. Did anyone else see it or know what it is?"

It's not the first time strange lights have been seen in the sky in Devon.

Last year, lights were seen in the sky over North Devon sparking rumours and theories as to what it was.
